*Daily values (DVs) are reference numbers based on the recommended dietary allowance. They were developed to help consumers determine if a food contains a lot or a little of a 
specific nutrient. The DV for potassium is 3500 mg. The %DV listed on the Nutrition Facts panel of food labels states the percentage of the DV provided in one serving. Percent 
DVs are based on a 2000-calorie diet.
